title: SharedData ACL may expose cloud API key, IPC capability and MITM CA signing key
description: Installer grants inheritable read access to BUILTIN Users while the engine persists high-impact credentials and a CA private key below SharedData.
claimed_root_cause: One shared ACL policy covers both public-readable data and privileged secret-bearing files.

trace.description: BU is granted inheritable GRGX on ProgramData directory
CA private PEM is written to file

evidence.description: Stored API key is used as x-api-key for Ace Server
Uses fs::write with no source-visible per-file DACL

blockers: No observed installed Windows ACL inheritance for actual secret files
No independent verifier or isolated Windows VM available

validation_plan.local: In disposable Windows VM with synthetic secrets inspect effective ACL metadata as a standard user; do not extract real private keys.
validation_plan.deployment: Release owner verifies ACL inheritance, CA private-key protection, token compatibility and key rotation design.

title: Local clients without capability can request complete backup data
description: export_backup and network-block getters pass required=false while transport grants local users client access.
claimed_root_cause: Read authorization intentionally differs from write authorization; sensitive backup export may cross an intended privacy boundary.

trace.description: Does not require the capability token

blockers: Intended confidentiality between users of one installation not established
No isolated runtime verification of unauthenticated dummy data read

validation_plan.local: In an isolated dummy installation, ask a capability-less local client to export a synthetic block and observe only synthetic output.
validation_plan.deployment: Document whether block names/rules are private per user; enforce authz if privacy is required.

title: Account-link callback lacks a source-visible request-bound nonce
description: Any web-originated aceblocker account-key callback can reach the local set_api_key operation after OS/browser handoff.
claimed_root_cause: Deep link is allowlisted by path but not visibly correlated to an app-initiated authentication request.

trace.description: Browser can present the scheme link
setApiKey is called with URL-delivered value
Persists submitted key to local account

evidence.description: Allowlist contains account/api-key only, not an app-bound state
API key parsed directly from URI fragment

blockers: External website's state validation is out of this repository
Browser/OS user confirmation and concrete unauthorized result not independently demonstrated

validation_plan.local: Two synthetic accounts on isolated test browser and engine; confirm whether unsolicited deep link can replace a currently linked dummy account.
validation_plan.deployment: Review cross-repo login state nonce binding, callback origin, replay controls and release OS confirmation behavior.
